title: Snake
description: Classic Snake with controller and touch steering, increasing speed, wall-wrap mode, and saved progress

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: Snake controls
items: Tilt the controller up, right, down or left to steer. Touch the direction buttons for the same controls.
Turn the knob one click to turn left or right relative to your direction of travel. Press the controller to pause and return to the menu.
Two turns can be queued for quick corners. Only one turn is used per movement step. Direct reversal is ignored; holding a direction does not repeat it.
Eat food to grow and score 10 points. Speed increases every five foods, up to its limit. Avoid your body and solid walls. Fill the entire board to win.
Difficulty and solid or wrap-around edges apply to new games. In wrap mode, leaving one edge brings you back at the opposite edge.
BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves. Calls, popups, leaving the app and vehicle movement pause play. Resume explicitly when ready; there is a short ready period before movement.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new game?
items: Your current saved game will be replaced. Your best score is kept.
